beats.speaker: Ando
beats.text: Golden hour on the piers, and that unit is still hunting.

beats.speaker: Sari-sari
beats.text: Anak, 'wag diyan. The prototype already leveled three blocks — including the garden.

beats.speaker: Ando
beats.text: Then one unit can fall. I'll put it down.

beats.speaker: Sari-sari
beats.text: The people who still write on paper are under Quiapo. After this, punta ka sa chapel.
